department: Biomedical Sciences (Lewis Katz School of Medicine)

deadline.value: Apply through BioMedCAS by February 15 for Fall entry; nomination for fellowships also uses February 15.
deadline.quote: Fall: February 15 | In order to be considered for nomination, prospective students must submit all application materials by February 15

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional for this PhD.
gre_general.quote: GRE: Optional. Students are not required to submit standardized scores, including GRE or MCAT scores, to supplement their application

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.quote: must report scores for a standardized test of English that meet these minimums: | TOEFL iBT: 79

app_fee.value: Applications go through BioMedCAS plus a supplemental Temple application, so the school sets its own fee; the pages reached do not state it.

fee_waiver.value: The school sets its own waiver rules through BioMedCAS; the pages reached do not state them.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students receive a stipend, health insurance and tuition remission.
funding.quote: All students are provided with a competitive stipend, health insurance and tuition remission

supervisor.value: Students do three research rotations before choosing a Dissertation Research Advisor.
supervisor.quote: Research training begins with three research rotations in the first year of the graduate program

entry_route.value: A master's degree is not required.
entry_route.quote: A master's degree is not required

notes: Applications go through BioMedCAS with a supplemental Temple application, so the school's own fee and waiver rules apply.
